Task 3 has one funded round available (`fund 1 fix rounds`, ledger 0 of 1 spent). It runs after the escalated round failed, and it repeats the escalated payload on the same tree.

## Funded round dispatch

**1. Record the spending before dispatch**

```text
funded round 1 of 1 for task 3
```

**2. Build the repair base** (isolated singleton wave) in the owning checkout:

```bash
RP_ROOT='/workspace/project'
RP_BASE='<WAVE_BASE_SHA>'
RP_DIR=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
RP_TREE="$RP_DIR/tree"
git -C "$RP_ROOT" add -A || exit 1
git -C "$RP_ROOT" diff --binary --cached "$RP_BASE" > "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" || exit 1
git -C "$RP_ROOT" worktree add --detach "$RP_TREE" "$RP_BASE" || exit 1
if [ -s "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" ]; then git -C "$RP_TREE" apply --index "$RP_DIR/integrated.patch" || exit 1; fi
git -C "$RP_TREE" -c user.name=gauntlet -c user.email=gauntlet@local commit -q --allow-empty -m "wave integrated snapshot" || exit 1
printf 'repair-base: %s %s\n' "$RP_TREE" "$(git -C "$RP_TREE" rev-parse HEAD)"
```

Observation: `repair-base: <RP_TREE> <snapshot sha>`

**3. Dispatch the funded implementer.** This uses the same payload, tree and anchors as the escalated round, with `model` set to the runtime-resolved `implModel`. It has no `context: "fresh"` and no prior-patch path.

```ts
subagent({ async: false, cwd: "<RP_TREE>", model: "<configured-impl-model>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "implementer", as: "impl_3", outputSchema: IMPLEMENTER_STATUS_SCHEMA,
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-task3-funded1.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      task: "planPath: <absolute plan>; anchor: ### Task 3:; Spec: <absolute home spec>; Leg: <owning leg>; Rules: <combined task/leg Rules, resolved in the owning checkout>; SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"]. Findings: [Moderate] src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard. ## Previous review report (re-review trigger) <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review4.md - read it yourself. Return one status: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS | BLOCKED | NEEDS_CONTEXT. pi-cohort saves your final report; do not write it yourself." }
  ], worktree: true,
     stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED", "NEEDS_CONTEXT", "DONE_WITH_CONCERNS"] } }]
})
```

Observation: `status: DONE`, with an `Artifacts:` patch.

**4. Integrate the delta and clean up**

```bash
git -C '/workspace/project' apply --index '<Artifacts dir>/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-0-implementer.patch'
git -C '/workspace/project' worktree remove --force '<RP_TREE>'
git -C '/workspace/project' add -A
git -C '/workspace/project' diff --stat --cached '<tree recorded at review 4>'
```

```text
wave <w> repair <k> task 3 DONE report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-task3-funded1.md delta <Artifacts dir>/worktree-diffs/step-0/task-0-implementer.patch applied yes
```

Observation: `diff --stat` is nonempty.

**5. Run the scoped gate**

```bash
(cd '/workspace/project' && node --test frame.test.mjs) > '<REPORT_DIR>/gate-1.log' 2>&1; echo "exit $?"
```

```text
wave <w> gate 1 exit 0
```

**6. Record the re-review tree** (Fix delta block):

```bash
FD_ROOT='/workspace/project'
FD_INDEX=$(mktemp) || exit 1
cp "$(git -C "$FD_ROOT" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path index)" "$FD_INDEX" || { rm -f "$FD_INDEX"; exit 1; }
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" add -A && GIT_INDEX_FILE="$FD_INDEX" git -C "$FD_ROOT" write-tree
FD_STATUS=$?
rm -f "$FD_INDEX"
exit "$FD_STATUS"
```

Observation: `<T5>`.

## Funded wave re-review

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "wave-reviewer", output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review5.md",
      outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: WAVE_VERDICT_SCHEMA,
      task: "planPath: <absolute plan>; anchors: [\"### Task 3:\"]; Spec: <absolute home spec>; Leg: <owning leg>; Rules: <combined task/leg Rules, resolved in the owning checkout>; Implementer reports: <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-task3-funded1.md; BASE_SHA: <WAVE_BASE_SHA>; HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE; SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: [\"node --test frame.test.mjs\"].\n## Previous review report (re-review trigger)\n<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review4.md\n## Fix delta\ntree-before: <T4>\ntree-after: <T5>\nRun git -C /workspace/project diff --binary <T4> <T5> yourself. Append the TRAJECTORY line as the true final line if issues remain." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/verdict", in: ["FIX_FIRST", "REJECT"] } }]
})
```

Observation: `FIX_FIRST`, with `TRAJECTORY: DIVERGING (3 -> 3, max severity Moderate)`.

```text
wave <w> review 5 verdict FIX_FIRST report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review5.md tree <T5>
```

## Transition

The funded round failed with an attributed `FIX_FIRST`. The funded ledger is now 1 of 1 spent, so no round remains and the run takes the stop-note path.

I do one bounded read of the final report for the residual finding:

```ts
read({ path: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-review5.md", limit: 300 })
```

Finding: `src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard`

State at this point:
- Task 3 stays `in_progress`.
- The phase stays `implement`.
- There is no commit and no tracker update.

---

gauntlet: question
Stopped on task 3 (Validate frame); escalated round on <configured-impl-model> did not resolve it.

Problem: The frame validator still accepts input without checking its length. This persisted through the escalated round and the only funded round.
budget: 1 of 1 spent
  src/frame.ts:21 - missing length guard

Fix options:
  a) add an explicit length check at src/frame.ts:21 that rejects frames shorter than the declared or required length before any field is read
  b) amend plan task 3 (or its spec section) to state the exact length rule the validator must enforce, then re-run the task
  c) grant more funded rounds in the Amend-grant line and retry with the same scope

Pick one, or give another fix.
Recommendation: a - a direct guard at the flagged line closes the one residual finding without changing the approved spec.
